verdict.rationale: Attio's own App SDK documents a bulk record action extension that appears when several record rows are selected in a list (attio-docs-63, attio-docs-95). This shows a first-party multi-select surface for acting on many records at once, but using it means building or installing an app. Object actions cover object-wide work such as imports and syncs (attio-docs-101). missing for 10: documented native bulk edit/update/delete for end users, bulk or batch REST/MCP endpoints, AI-driven bulk changes across many records, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
